one_line: AI funding hits record levels, NVIDIA expands tools across Europe, AI security risks surface, policy debates intensify.

themes.title: AI firms chase record funding
themes.text: DeepSeek secured roughly $15 billion and OpenAI is negotiating up to $30 billion, valuing the latter at $1.25 trillion.

stories.headline: DeepSeek raises about $15 billion in funding round days after US restrictions
OpenAI seeks up to $30 billion funding at $1.25 trillion valuation ahead of IPO

themes.title: NVIDIA expands tools and European use
themes.text: NVIDIA launched Minerva AIOps, Cosmos training extensions, and DSX power‑bottleneck platform while European governments, retailers, banks, and industrial partners adopted its open‑weight models for services ranging from climate forecasting to cost‑effective inference.

stories.headline: NVIDIA launches Minerva AIOps platform for AI factory observability
NVIDIA open models adopted in European public sector projects
European firms adopt NVIDIA Earth‑2 models for weather and climate forecasting
European retailers cut inference costs up to 90% using NVIDIA open models
European banks and fintechs adopt NVIDIA open‑weight models for proprietary AI
NVIDIA expands Cosmos platform with new training tools and data factory blueprints
NVIDIA DSX platform used to address power bottleneck in AI infrastructure
Schneider Electric, NVIDIA and HPE launch Industrial AI Agents at the Edge

themes.title: AI reveals and enables security threats
themes.text: AI models identified critical PHP memory‑safety bugs affecting up to 70% of websites, and Chinese‑aligned hackers used an open‑source AI framework to breach thousands of Microsoft 365 tenants.

stories.headline: AI tools uncover critical PHP vulnerabilities affecting up to 70% of websites
Chinese hackers used AI agents to breach ConnectWise and access 2,250 Microsoft 365 tenants

themes.title: Policy focus on AI trust
themes.text: India announced a domestic framework for evaluating AI trustworthiness in defence, the US is expected to maintain a light‑touch regulatory stance, and Anthropic argued that training on song lyrics is fair use.

stories.headline: India creates domestic framework to evaluate AI trustworthiness in defence
US unlikely to adopt major AI regulations as UBS predicts light‑touch approach
Anthropic argues fair use for song lyrics in Claude training as US judge hears case
